nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: Receives operations.Pinged from the worker's fan-out. The raw body is kept as binary so the signature is checked over the exact bytes that were signed.

nodes.name: Signature Matches?
nodes.notes: A body whose signature does not match is dropped: the false branch is deliberately unconnected.

nodes.name: Echo
nodes.notes: No outbound call. This workflow exists so the phase's spine is observable: one execution here per event delivered, however many times it was sent.
